blurb: Guests board a boat for a relaxing cruise around Portland's scenic Casco Bay, enjoying views of lighthouses, wildlife, and historic forts. The boat accommodates up to an unspecified number of guests and has a stocked cooler with items available for purchase. Guests can bring their own snacks and soft drinks and can request specific sights or special celebration arrangements.
